## Overview

This project was one of the many proposed projects for the Advanced Programming course (Spring Semester 2024) at Amirkabir University of Technology.
Students were provided with a guide, and later with necessary imports:
```Java
import org.jsoup.*;
import org.w3c.dom.Element;
import org.w3c.dom.NodeList;
import org.w3c.dom.Node;
import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilder;
import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilderFactory;
import java.net.*;
```
